heading_context_en: Architecture Decision Register / Consistency and Open Questions / Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies
Architecture Decision Register / Consistency and Open Questions / Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies
text_en: 1. **Preserve baseline invariants and scope immediately.** Follow the confirmed requirements and RES-001–012 without adopting adjacent unresolved mechanics.

heading_context_en: Architecture Decision Register / Consistency and Open Questions / Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies
text_en: 2. **Confirm identity, authorization, provider and retention boundaries.** These constrain public contracts, data placement, model routes, reviewer eligibility and lifecycle authority.

heading_context_en: Architecture Decision Register / Consistency and Open Questions / Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies
text_en: 3. **Define controlled schemas and state/policy contracts.** Resolve canonical endpoints, identities, field mappings, policy inputs, exact-artifact binding and safe errors before generating executable clients or migrations.

heading_context_en: Architecture Decision Register / Consistency and Open Questions / Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies
text_en: 4. **Confirm transaction, replay and concurrency mechanics.** These depend on approved aggregates, schemas and authority; include claims, fencing, expiry races and operation-specific completion.

heading_context_en: Architecture Decision Register / Consistency and Open Questions / Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies
text_en: 5. **Confirm runtime settings and operational protocols.** Finalize quotas, timeouts, schedules, thresholds, recovery, compensation, archive and notification behavior.

heading_context_en: Architecture Decision Register / Consistency and Open Questions / Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies
text_en: 6. **Finalize UI projections and verification fixtures.** Navigation, required fields, failure recovery and metrics depend on approved contracts. Accessibility and authorization requirements remain active throughout.

heading_context_en: Architecture Decision Register / Consistency and Open Questions / Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies
text_en: 7. **Close only the answered question.** Record the explicit confirming statement and all affected original IDs. Leave any remaining subquestion open rather than closing a consolidated range wholesale.

heading_context_en: Architecture Decision Register / Consistency and Open Questions / Confirmation Order Implied by Dependencies
text_en: No unresolved item authorizes an implementation AI to select a technology, numerical limit, owner, deadline or design option independently.
